mainEntity.name: What does a project cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting prices are on our Pricing page — for example, websites start from R18,000. After a short conversation you get a clear written quote covering scope, deliverables and timing before any work begins. Nothing starts until you approve it.

mainEntity.name: How do we start working together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send an enquiry, message us on WhatsApp or book a meeting. We talk through your goals, then send a written quote covering scope, deliverables, responsibilities, budget and timing. Nothing starts until you approve it.

mainEntity.name: Who will work on my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our core team of three: our founder (strategy, UX/UI design and frontend), a graphic designer and animator, and a certified backend and AI engineer. You work with us directly from the first conversation to launch — meet the team on our About page.

mainEntity.name: What does working with you look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Review points are planned into your scope, so you see progress and give feedback before the next stage. Questions can go through WhatsApp, email or a booked call, and the agreed journeys are tested end to end before launch.

mainEntity.name: How long does a project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smaller design or setup work can move quickly; connected systems take longer. Timing is discussed and agreed before work starts, and kept visible through planned review points.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with businesses outside South Africa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LulaZel Digital Studio works remotely with businesses worldwide, whatever your time zone.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a technical brief before we talk?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Bring the problem you want to solve — goals, examples and what you use today all help, but a complete technical brief is not required.

mainEntity.name: What do hosting, payments and AI cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Those services come from the providers you choose and are billed under their terms. We set them up, connect them and manage them to the agreed scope; their fees are yours to pay directly to them.

mainEntity.name: What happens after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive everything we agreed — access, assets and documentation. Ongoing support and maintenance options are available and agreed before the work starts.
